A.depoimento: Ordered five spearmen to Santarem and three knights to Evora; they will march and engage next turn. Built four spearmen in Lisboa for future reinforcements.
A.plano: Capture Santarem and Evora this turn to gain two villages and their production. Next turn, reinforce these new holdings and push along the road network toward Salamanca and Toledo, aiming to control the central corridor. Simultaneously, build spearmen in Lisboa to replenish forces. Continue expanding outward, securing neutral villages and preparing to assault the enemy capital Barcelona.

B.depoimento: Sent three spearmen to Tarragona and three knights to Girona to seize the neutral villages. Retained two spearmen and four archers at Barcelona for defense. Built two spearmen using available wood.
B.plano: Capture Tarragona and Girona this turn with spearmen and knights. Keep a garrison of spearmen and archers at Barcelona. Build two spearmen to replace losses. Next turn, reinforce captured villages and prepare to push further east.

A.depoimento: Sent troops to take Coimbra, Badajoz, and Faro; started building spearmen in Lisboa to strengthen our army.
A.plano: Capture Coimbra, Badajoz, and Faro next turn to expand to six holdings. Reinforce these new villages and push along the road toward Salamanca and Toledo to seize the central corridor. Continue building spearmen in Lisboa to replenish forces and prepare for further expansion toward the enemy capital.

B.depoimento: This turn I trained fresh spearmen at Barcelona, sent reinforcements to Tarragona, and launched archer and knight detachments toward Huesca and Zaragoza. My heartlands stand firm while the east prepares to fall.
B.plano: Next turn, use reinforced Tarragona to attack Castellon with spearmen. Huesca and Zaragoza forces en route; prepare to garrison captured villages. Continue building spearmen in Barcelona for future pushes.

A.depoimento: Built archers in Lisboa and Santarem, a spearman in Evora. Sent Lisboa archers and Faro archer to Badajoz, Santarem spearmen to Coimbra, and Evora knights to Faro to strengthen our front.
A.plano: Capture Coimbra this turn via spear waves from Lisboa and Santarem. Next turn, seize Badajoz with archers from Lisboa and Faro. Reinforce new holdings and advance along the road to Salamanca and Toledo to control the central corridor. Continue building spearmen in Lisboa to replenish forces.

B.depoimento: I sent three spearmen from Tarragona to take Castellon and a knight from Huesca to seize Zaragoza. I also trained two new spearmen in Barcelona to replenish our ranks. The march begins now; victory awaits.
B.plano: Next turn, expect to have captured Castellon and Zaragoza; reinforce them with available troops; continue building spearmen in Barcelona for future pushes; watch for enemy movements from unexplored areas.

B.depoimento: Built an archer in Barcelona. Marched Huesca's archer and knight toward Valencia to take the neutral village. Strengthening our front for further expansion.
B.plano: Expect to capture Valencia in three turns. Reinforce newly taken villages and continue building archers in Barcelona for future pushes. Keep watch on enemy movements from unexplored areas.

A.depoimento: Built one archer in Faro. Sent all three knights from Faro to seize Badajoz, expanding our territory to six villages.
A.plano: Capture Badajoz this turn to gain a forward base. Next turn reinforce Badajoz and build archers in Faro to counter Sevilha's spearmen. Then attack Sevilha with archers (counter) while preparing to take Porto and Salamanca using spearmen from Coimbra after securing the flanks.

A.depoimento: This turn I moved archers from Santarem and Faro to Lisboa, pulled spearmen from Lisboa and Evora to Coimbra, and sent Badajoz’s three knights to seize Salamanca. I also began building an archer in Lisboa and two spearmen in Coimbra.
A.plano: Consolidate archers in Lisboa and spearmen in Coimbra. Use Badajoz's knights to take Salamanca this turn. Next turn, launch archer strikes on Sevilha and Porto while marching spearmen to seize Toledo. Then advance toward the enemy capital through Zaragoza.

A.depoimento: Marched 9 spearmen from Coimbra to Porto, capturing the village and leaving a garrison of 7 spearmen. Kept 3 spearmen to defend Coimbra. Began training 4 archers in Lisboa for future offensives.
A.plano: Secure Porto this turn, then hold Coimbra and Lisboa. Build archers in Lisboa to counter spearman villages. Next turn reinforce Coimbra with knights from Salamanca and prepare to assault Sevilha and Toledo via Badajoz/Faro. Expand to control central Spain and push toward the enemy capital.

B.depoimento: Today we ordered spear production in every village to strengthen our reserves. We sent Barcelona's full contingent of spears and archers toward Teruel, hoping to claim that neutral village and expand our realm.
B.plano: Barcelona's army marches to Teruel (arrives in 3 turns). Continue building spears in all villages to replenish forces. Keep a small garrison at Barcelona for defense. Do not split forces; focus on securing Teruel first.

A.depoimento: Sent Lisboa's archers to Santarem, moved Coimbra's spearmen and Salamanca's knights to Porto, and built spearmen at Santarem plus archers at Evora to strengthen our southern front.
A.plano: Stage archers at Santarem and Evora for upcoming assaults on Toledo and Sevilha. Reinforce Porto with spearmen and knights to prepare for pushes toward Vigo and Madrid. Build local troops to sustain the offensive and replace losses.

B.depoimento: We dispatched a strong contingent from Castellon to capture Valencia, leaving a light garrison. Our march on Teruel continues, and we bolster our ranks with new spearmen across the realm.
B.plano: Next turn: reinforce Castellon and Valencia garrisons, continue spear production, prepare to seize Teruel with the incoming Barcelona army or fresh forces. Keep all villages defended, avoid splitting forces.

A.depoimento: Sent Santarem’s garrison to Badajoz and Evora’s archers to Faro to strengthen our front lines. Ordered Porto’s spearmen and knights to march on Vigo. Began building spearmen, archers and knights in every village to prepare for next turn’s assaults.
A.plano: Push on four fronts – Porto to Vigo, Badajoz to Toledo, Faro to Sevilha, Salamanca to Madrid. Reinforce Badajoz and Faro with infantry from Santarem and Evora. Build troops at all villages to sustain the offensive and replace losses. Aim to capture at least four neutral villages next turn and hold them.

B.depoimento: This turn I focused on building archers across my villages to prepare for upcoming offensives. I held my current territories and did not launch any attacks, conserving forces for the next push. My economy remains strong with ample iron and wood reserves.
B.plano: Next turn: archers from Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona, Castellon, Zaragoza, Huesca will be ready. Use them to seize Murcia and Pamplona (1 turn from Valencia/Zaragoza). Reinforce Teruel with the incoming Barcelona army and hold. Continue spear production in villages with spare wood. Keep all villages defended.

A.depoimento: I attack Toledo and Sevilha from Badajoz, send spearmen and a knight from Porto to strengthen Salamanca and Vigo for future offensives, and build troops to sustain the campaign.
A.plano: Capture Toledo and Sevilha next turn, then use reinforced Salamanca and Vigo to take Madrid and Burgos in the following turns, expanding production to push toward the enemy capital.

A.depoimento: Today I ordered archers from six of our interior villages to march to Toledo, massing forces for an upcoming strike on Teruel. Our spearmen hold the line while the archers prepare to counter the enemy's spear-heavy garrison. With this buildup, we aim to seize Teruel next turn and expand our control.
A.plano: Gather archers at Toledo via Badajoz, Santarem, Evora, Faro, Salamanca, and Sevilha. Once sufficient mass is reached, assault Teruel to gain a foothold. After securing Teruel, advance to capture Cordoba, Madrid, and Burgos, then push toward the enemy capital.

A.depoimento: I ordered spearmen and a knight built across my realms to strengthen my forces. I marched Toledo's archers to take Cordoba, while sending Badajoz spearmen to bolster Toledo's defenses. My armies advance to expand our hold.
A.plano: Secure Cordoba this turn, reinforce Toledo with incoming archers and Badajoz spearmen, then build spearmen to counter Madrid knights. Next turn attack Madrid, then Teruel, then Burgos, and push toward the enemy capital.

A.depoimento: We launched attacks on Madrid from Salamanca, Teruel from Toledo and Murcia from Cordoba. We reinforced our interior villages with new spearmen and archers to replace losses and prepare for future offensives. No enemy armies were sighted on the march.
A.plano: Having taken Cordoba, this turn we strike Madrid, Teruel and Murcia. Next turn we will mass spearmen at Vigo to capture Burgos, then advance through Valencia and Zaragoza toward the enemy capital. We continue to build spearmen and archers in the interior to sustain the push.

B.depoimento: This turn I maximized knight production in all my villages, converting wood and iron into a powerful cavalry reserve. No troops were sent out; I fortified my holdings and prepared for a swift expansion next turn.
B.plano: Next turn, use newly built knights to attack Toledo and capture nearby neutral villages (Madrid, Murcia, Pamplona). Keep some troops for defense and continue building archers for flexibility. Do not split forces; send full strength from each village.

A.depoimento:
I ordered archers from Toledo to take Teruel.
I sent Vigo's full garrison to capture Burgos.
Meanwhile, I built spearmen and archers in the interior to reinforce our forces.
A.plano:
After taking Cordoba last turn, this turn we seize Teruel and Burgos.
Next turn we will mass spearmen at Vigo and Toledo to strike Valencia and Zaragoza, then push toward the enemy capital Barcelona.

B.depoimento: This turn we struck Murcia with two knights from Valencia, reinforced Zaragoza with spearmen and knights from Tarragona and Girona, and increased archer production across our villages to prepare for the next push.
B.plano: Next turn, use Zaragoza's spearmen to attack Madrid and capture it. Continue building archers in Teruel, Girona, and Tarragona for a future Toledo assault. Keep reinforcing border villages and maintain defenses. Do not split forces; concentrate attacks.

A.depoimento: This turn I dispatched eight archers from Faro to seize Teruel and sent four spearmen from Salamanca to bolster Madrid's defenses. Holding the line while preparing the next push.
A.plano:
- Capture Teruel with archers from Faro.
- Reinforce Madrid with spearmen from Salamanca to withstand Zaragoza.
- Next turn, take Burgos using archers from Vigo or Evora.
- Mass spearmen at Toledo and Vigo to strike Valencia and Zaragoza.
- Advance toward enemy capital Barcelona.

B.depoimento: This turn I seized Madrid and Pamplona from Zaragoza, sent Valencian spearmen to bolster Murcia, and ordered archer production in the east. My lines hold and I prepare for the next push.
B.plano: Next turn, keep Zaragoza's garrison ready, prepare Toledo assault using archers from Teruel, Girona, and Tarragona, and keep Murcia reinforced. Do not launch unsupported attacks; focus on holding gains.

B.depoimento: Sent troops to strengthen Teruel and capture Burgos; built spearmen at Zaragoza; our march to Pamplona will likely fall but we secured key positions.
B.plano: Hold Teruel with reinforcements, take Burgos from Madrid, keep Madrid garrison strong, build spearmen at Zaragoza for future, accept loss of Pamplona march.

B.depoimento: Sent spearmen from Huesca to Pamplona, knights from Huesca to Salamanca, and knights from Burgos to Vigo. No new troops built this turn.
B.plano: Capture Pamplona, Salamanca, and Vigo to raise our held villages to 14. Keep strong garrisons at home to deter enemy reprisals. Avoid attacking Toledo or Cordoba this turn due to lack of sufficient forces.

A.depoimento: We attacked Vigo with Porto's garrison, reinforced Salamanca with troops from Coimbra and Santarem, and ordered spearmen production in all our villages to strengthen our army.
A.plano: Capture Vigo to expand our border, then push toward Burgos and Madrid while holding Salamanca against the incoming enemy army. Build spearmen everywhere to replenish forces and prepare for further offensives.

B.depoimento: This turn I dispatched knight squadrons from Teruel to Toledo, spear columns from Burgos and Zaragoza to Pamplona, a knight detachment from Vigo to Porto, and spear troops from Murcia to Cordoba. All movements aim to seize these villages next turn.
B.plano: Continue pressing on Toledo, Pamplona, Cordoba, and Porto with fast-moving forces to capture them by turn 24. Hold garrisons at home to deter enemy counterattacks. Avoid splitting troops too thin; keep reserves for defense. Do not engage Salamanca or Toledo with insufficient forces this turn.

A.depoimento: Built spearmen in all interior villages to stockpile forces. Sent Vigo's garrison to take the undefended Burgos, and Cordoba's troops to overcome Murcia's knight. Secured two new villages without loss.
A.plano: Capture Burgos and Murcia this turn to expand our border. Next turn, reinforce Salamanca with arriving troops and attack Madrid; reinforce Toledo to press Teruel. Hold the line while building spearmen everywhere for future offensives.

B.depoimento: This turn I sent troops from Pamplona to Burgos, Valencia to Murcia, Castellon to Teruel, and Huesca to Zaragoza to strengthen key defenses. I also ordered production of archers in Madrid and Teruel to prepare for future offensives. No attacks were launched due to insufficient force.
B.plano: Reinforce border villages (Burgos, Murcia, Teruel, Zaragoza) and build archers in Madrid and Teruel for future counterattacks. Hold defenses against enemy incursions. Do not launch risky attacks with insufficient forces this turn.

A.depoimento: Today we ordered a wave of archer production in all our villages to strengthen our forces. We sent troops from Murcia to seize the undefended Valencia and from Salamanca to take Madrid. Cordoba reinforced Toledo for the upcoming push on Teruel.
A.plano: Capture Valencia and Madrid this turn to reach 15 held villages. Next turn, reinforce Toledo and attack Teruel; use Porto to take Burgos. Continue building archers everywhere to boost counter‑attack power against enemy spearmen. Hold the line while expanding.

B.depoimento:
We sent a single spearman to capture the undefended Vigo.
Teruel's archers marched to Valencia to bolster its defense.
A mixed force from Zaragoza reinforced Madrid, while we built troops across our villages.
B.plano:
Capture Vigo and reinforce Valencia with Teruel's archers to defend against Murcia.
Strengthen Madrid with troops from Zaragoza and build spearmen/archers across our holdings.
Avoid risky attacks on strong enemy positions like Salamanca or Toledo.

A.depoimento:
We built archers in most villages and added knights in Vigo and Murcia for a fast striking force.
We sent reinforcements from Coimbra, Badajoz, and Porto to strengthen Salamanca and Toledo.
Our rear villages kept enough troops to hold the line while we prepare the offense.
A.plano:
Build archers everywhere and knights in Vigo and Murcia for fast offense.
Reinforce Salamanca and Toledo via Coimbra, Badajoz, Porto.
Next turn, attack Madrid and Teruel from Toledo with strengthened archer-heavy force.
Use knights from Vigo and Murcia to take Burgos and Valencia.
Continue building archers to maintain counter advantage.

B.depoimento: This turn we trained scores of archers in our towns, sent a mixed archer-knight detachment to take Salamanca, shipped Teruel’s archers to bolster Valencia, and marched Zaragoza’s spearmen and knights to fortify Madrid.
B.plano: Capture Salamanca with archer-heavy force from Madrid. Reinforce Valencia and Madrid to secure borders. Continue building archers across holdings for future pushes. Avoid assaulting Toledo or Cordoba until we have stronger knight contingents.

A.depoimento: I ordered Toledo to strike at Madrid with a strong spear-archer force, while Vigo hit Burgos with archer-knight troops. Reinforcements flowed from Badajoz and Cordoba to bolster Toledo, and I commanded spear production across all villages to stockpile for the coming battles.
A.plano: Take Madrid this turn with Toledo's forces, then reinforce Toledo over the next turns to capture Teruel. Vigo will hold Burgos after its attack. Build spears everywhere and archers in Salamanca and Toledo to prepare for future pushes toward Valencia.

A.depoimento: We seized Pamplona with archers and knights from Burgos, securing our northern flank. Simultaneously, we ordered a massive spearman buildup across our realms and added archers to Salamanca and Toledo to prepare for counterattacks against enemy spear-heavy armies.
A.plano: Hold Pamplona and build spearmen everywhere while adding archers to Salamanca and Toledo. Next turn reinforce the Madrid attack with Toledo's marching army and local forces, then take Teruel. After that, push toward Valencia using the Burgos-Pamplona corridor.

A.depoimento: Built spearmen in all villages to boost defenses. Sent a mixed force from Salamanca to Teruel and a knight force from Murcia to Zaragoza to seize two enemy towns this turn and next.
A.plano: Capture Zaragoza with Murcia's knights this turn; capture Teruel with Salamanca's mixed army in three turns. Reinforce Zaragoza with archers from Murcia and other villages to defend against Teruel counter. After securing Zaragoza, advance toward Valencia via Burgos-Pamplona corridor, building spears everywhere to strengthen garrison.

B.depoimento: We strengthened our borders by moving troops from interior villages, sending archers to Zaragoza, knights to Valencia and Huesca, and spearmen from Teruel and Huesca to Zaragoza. Simultaneously, we ordered production of knights and archers in our towns to replace sent troops and build up striking power for upcoming turns.
B.plano: Reinforce border defenses: send archers to Zaragoza, knights to Valencia and Huesca, and spearmen from Teruel and Huesca to Zaragoza. Build knights and archers in interior villages to replenish forces and prepare for future offensives. Do not launch attacks this turn until defenses are solid.

A.depoimento:
Built a knight in Toledo.
Readied 17 spears, 6 archers, and the new knight to attack Teruel next turn.
A.plano: Capture Teruel with Toledo's spear-heavy force next turn, then use its resources to reinforce and push toward Huesca or Valencia, aiming to hold 18 villages for two consecutive turns.

B.depoimento: Sent reinforcements from Teruel and Huesca to Zaragoza, built archers in Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona, and Castellon. Held border villages with small garrisons to defend against enemy incursions.
B.plano: Reinforce Zaragoza with troops from Teruel and Huesca while keeping minimal garrisons. Build archers in interior villages to stockpile for future offensives. Do not attack enemy villages this turn; focus on defense and preparation.
